title: Open table formats: Delta Lake, Iceberg and Hudi

videos.script: A directory of Parquet files is not a table. Run a nightly append twice, and January's purchases are counted twice, with nothing in the directory to say so. {{twice}} Delta Lake, Iceberg and Hudi fix it the same way: a log of commits beside the files. The table is whatever the log says it is. {{log}} With a log, a retried job writes nothing the second time. A visitor's rows can be deleted with one statement. And the table can be read as it was before. {{delete}} History is not free, though. Compact thirty-one small files into one, vacuum the old ones, and the version that pointed to them can no longer be read. {{vacuum}} Three formats, one idea. Which one to use depends on what reads the table. {{choose}}
